mapper.select: SELECT id, sku_id, total_stock, available_stock, locked_stock, warn_stock, version FROM inventory WHERE sku_id = #{skuId} AND deleted = 0
SELECT id, sku_id, total_stock, available_stock, locked_stock, warn_stock, version, create_time, update_time FROM inventory WHERE deleted = 0 AND sku_id = #{skuId} ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inventory (id, sku_id, total_stock, available_stock, locked_stock, warn_stock, version, create_time, update_time, deleted) VALUES (#{id}, #{skuId}, #{totalStock}, #{availableStock}, #{lockedStock}, #{warnStock}, 0, NOW(), NOW(), 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE inventory SET total_stock = total_stock + #{qty}, available_stock = available_stock + #{qty}, version = version + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE sku_id = #{skuId} AND deleted = 0

UPDATE inventory SET available_stock = available_stock - #{qty}, locked_stock = locked_stock + #{qty}, version = version + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE sku_id = #{skuId} AND deleted = 0 AND available_stock >= #{qty}

UPDATE inventory SET locked_stock = locked_stock - #{qty}, total_stock = total_stock - #{qty}, version = version + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE sku_id = #{skuId} AND deleted = 0 AND locked_stock >= #{qty}

UPDATE inventory SET locked_stock = locked_stock - #{qty}, available_stock = available_stock + #{qty}, version = version + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE sku_id = #{skuId} AND deleted = 0 AND locked_stock >= #{qty}
